release_gates: Pinned source and upstream wheel hashes
Exact PE export set equals the union of NumPy PE import tables
Isolated Wine import and NumPy array operations
float32/float64/complex64/complex128 GEMM, solve, inverse, SVD, eig, eigh, least-squares, QR and Cholesky
Singular, non-positive-definite and ill-conditioned numerical cases
Concurrent NumPy subprocess imports and threaded SVD
Two clean builds must be byte-identical before coordinated publication
